info.title: ISK Lenses API
info.description: Public storefront, shopper, integration, and authenticated administration endpoints. Native app requests may omit Origin; browser-originated mutations must be same-origin. Responses use JSON unless noted otherwise.

tags.name: Shopper
tags.description: Shopper session, COD checkout, and account order history.

tags.name: Integrations
tags.description: Store chatbot, public knowledge, media delivery, error reporting, and Meta webhooks.

tags.name: Admin
tags.description: Authenticated administrative reads and supported REST mutations.

get.description: Returns active Buy X Get Y Free and percentage bundle offers. Every selected category must be represented in each qualifying bundle. Only the single best qualifying offer applies; offers do not stack.

get.summary: Find the latest available Android app
get.description: Returns the Android APK hosted at the production website's /isklenses.apk path.

200.description: The website-hosted Android APK is available for download.

get.description: Without pagination parameters, returns the full legacy catalog list. Send page to use bounded pagination; page size defaults to 24 and limit is capped at 100. Toric lens types are included in the Toric category and expose orderingPolicy requiring WhatsApp confirmation and advance payment.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: One-based page. Required when limit is supplied.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Case-insensitive product search across names, descriptions, SKUs, brands, categories, lens attributes, features, and specifications.

200.description: Product data; paginated requests also include total and page metadata.

get.description: Returns at most 15 items per page for the homepage categories, brands, shades or lens-types carousels. Pass q to search (search results are not capped). Web and mobile carousels fetch subsequent pages as the reader nears the end; autoplay advances every 3 seconds with a shared random carousel style (coverflow, fade-slide, infinite-loop, smooth-slide, continuous).

Returns the shared storefront home data used by web and mobile clients, including canonical hero banners, normalized appearance and palette settings, ordered/visible homepage sections, hero layout/autoplay, site chrome with configured delivery announcements and the trustNotice text, active catalog directories/products, and approved reviews.

Returns baseCurve fixed at 8.66, waterContent from the supported set, and the SEO fields seoTitle, seoDescription, and seoFocusKeywords. Toric products expose orderingPolicy with mode whatsapp_advance_payment, notice and whatsappUrl. Non-Toric products have a null orderingPolicy.

post.summary: Record an anonymous product view and get recent viewer count
post.description: Send a new random UUID v4 for each product-view session and repeat at most once per minute while visible. Count represents anonymous sessions seen in the preceding 120 seconds, not verified people or an instantaneous count. Stop heartbeats when hidden. The endpoint stores only a hash of the identifier and does not use customer identity. Responses are not cached.

viewerId.description: Random UUID version 4, regenerated for each product-view session.

get.description: Returns the full text of the currently published code-managed articles. Articles are general information, not medical advice.

image.description: Same-origin path to an original illustration, not product photography.

get.description: Returns links to third-party publishers. Their articles are not hosted by ISK and may change independently.

200.description: Lens types with associated product counts.

get.description: Use the returned subtotal ranges to display a delivery quote at checkout. The order endpoint independently recalculates and validates the quote.

get.summary: Obtain a short-lived sealed public-catalog live query
get.description: Returns the public Neon Realtime URL and a short-lived capability for the aggregate active-catalog version query. This endpoint exposes no customer or administrative data. Responses are private and non-cacheable. Returns 503 until Neon Realtime is configured.

get.summary: List approved reviews for a published product
get.description: Returns approved reviews and settings.enabled, settings.allowSubmission, and settings.autoApprove. Clients must respect enabled and allowSubmission when displaying reviews and submission controls.

200.description: Approved reviews and review display/submission settings.

post.description: Subject to store review settings and rate limiting. Reviews may be held for approval.

get.summary: Get an authorized order's current details
get.description: Use the order UUID from the signed-in shopper's order list, or the literal receipt for the latest signed receipt cookie. A receipt also grants access to its matching UUID. Returns only the account owner's order or the order authorized by that cookie. Latest receipt cookies issued at checkout expire after 90 days; a later checkout replaces the previous receipt cookie. Older issued cookies retain their original expiry. Status is the store's current order status; there is no separate courier tracking or per-item transit data.

404.description: Order does not exist or is not accessible to this session.

200.description: Current shopper and latest account-owned shipping address, or null values for a guest; no-store. Only account-owned orders are used.

savedShippingAddress.description: Latest account-owned order's editable shipping address, or null.

post.summary: Register, sign in, or sign out
post.description: On register/login, retain the HttpOnly isk-lenses-customer-session cookie using the client platform's cookie jar. Native requests may omit Origin. A logout clears the current cookie; account-wide session revocation is not provided.

200.description: Signed in or signed out; login sets the session cookie.

201.description: Account created and signed in; sets the session cookie.

post.description: Prices, stock, and delivery fees are revalidated on the server. Toric products cannot be ordered via cash on delivery and return 409; confirm them through WhatsApp and arrange full advance payment. checkoutKey must be a UUID and should remain unchanged across retries of the same checkout attempt. Native clients may omit Origin. Rate limited.

409.description: Price, stock, idempotency or Toric ordering policy conflict.

get.description: Returns up to 50 order summaries. Use each order's id with GET /api/storefront/orders/{orderId} for details.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Optional product search; up to eight matches.

200.description: FAQ, public product facts, product lens specifications, and assistant safety guidance.

post.description: Grounds answers in current published catalog listings and public FAQs. Requests mentioning WhatsApp include an external wa.me support link in links, including when medical or order-status guidance takes priority. When configured, a stateless server-side Mastra agent uses Vercel AI Gateway; otherwise deterministic matching is used. Does not access orders or customer accounts, and redirects medical or lens-fitting questions to an eye-care professional. Rate limited to 20 requests per IP per 10 minutes.

200.description: Grounded store answer and links, which may include the external WhatsApp support URL.

503.description: Assistant is disabled in store settings.

200.description: Public enabled state and welcome message.

put.description: Requires an admin or owner session cookie. Native requests may omit Origin; browser-originated requests must be same-origin.

get.summary: List admin products with media and variants

200.description: Product management records, including baseCurve, waterContent, seoTitle, seoDescription, and seoFocusKeywords.

post.description: baseCurve is fixed at 8.66 mm. waterContent must be 38%, 40%, 45%, 48%, 50%, 55%, 58%, or 60%. seoTitle and seoDescription are optional strings; seoFocusKeywords accepts up to 20 phrases. Canonical URLs are generated from slug. diameterMm is a single value: 14, 14.2, 14.5, or 14.8 mm, or a legacy value from 0 to 12 in 0.1 increments. Customer-selectable diameter lists are not supported.

200.description: Product record, including baseCurve, waterContent, seoTitle, seoDescription, and seoFocusKeywords.

put.description: baseCurve is fixed at 8.66 mm. waterContent must be 38%, 40%, 45%, 48%, 50%, 55%, 58%, or 60%. seoTitle and seoDescription are optional strings; seoFocusKeywords accepts up to 20 phrases. Canonical URLs are generated from slug. diameterMm is a single value: 14, 14.2, 14.5, or 14.8 mm, or a legacy value from 0 to 12 in 0.1 increments. Customer-selectable diameter lists are not supported.

get.summary: Paginated homepage product tab (15 per page)
Free Cosmetic gift offer for checkout
get.description: Returns whether the free gift is enabled, its rules (maxItems, minLensQuantity, badge, title, message), eligible in-stock gift products and minimumSubtotalCents=250000. Clients should offer gift choice only during checkout, when the discounted merchandise subtotal is at least PKR 2,500, no deal applies, and the required non-gift lens quantity is met; POST /api/orders revalidates the choice.

minimumSubtotalCents.description: The minimum discounted merchandise subtotal for gift eligibility, in PKR cents.

200.description: Products with featured, new-arrival, and sale flags.

value.description: Price for set; signed number for percent/amount

patch.summary: Bulk add, remove or replace product power lens values

200.description: Products with featured, new-arrival, and sale flags.

AdminJsonObject.description: JSON object validated by the named admin operation; server-side field, role, and business-rule validation remains authoritative.

categoryIds.description: Every selected category must have a distinct item in each bundle; the category count cannot exceed the bundle size.

whatsappSupportUrl.description: WhatsApp support chat link with a suggested message. The shopper confirms sending in WhatsApp.

deliveryNotice.description: Configured delivery fee or free-delivery threshold announcement.

trustNotice.description: FDA notice text displayed in the persistent storefront announcement ticker.

PowerLensValue.description: Exact lens power in diopters, e.g. -2.25 or 0.00.

surcharge.description: Extra price per eye when this power is chosen.

PowerRangeOption.description: One of the supported 0.50-diopter ranges from 0.00 through 12.00.

availablePowerRanges.description: Legacy grouped ranges resolved for this product (kept for backwards compatibility).

seoFocusKeywords.description: Up to 20 product focus keywords maintained by the catalog admin.

availablePowerOptions.description: Configurable exact power options enabled for this product, each with a per-eye surcharge. If non-empty, shoppers choose plain lenses at base price or select an option for each eye.

email.description: Optional for guests (empty string or valid email); ignored for signed-in shoppers.

lensChoice.description: For products with power options, explicitly send plain with both power values null or power with both values selected. Existing clients may omit this field when both valid power values are supplied. Omit for products without power options.

leftPowerRange.description: For power lenses, an available exact value for the left eye. For plain lenses, omit or send null.

rightPowerRange.description: For power lenses, an available exact value for the right eye. For plain lenses, omit or send null.

quotedUnitPrice.description: Base price plus left and right power surcharges; compared in cents with the server price.

quotedDeliveryFee.description: Current delivery quote shown to the shopper; the server validates it.

giftProductId.description: Optional free gift product id from GET /api/storefront/gift. Requires giftConfirmed=true, at least minLensQuantity non-gift units, a discounted merchandise subtotal of at least PKR 2,500, and no applied lens deal. The server recomputes all deal eligibility and pricing.

giftConfirmed.description: Must be true when giftProductId is set.

availablePowerRanges.description: Power ranges customers can select for each eye.
